frequency_question: How often do majority parties pass their flagship voting/electoral integrity bills when they prioritize them in a given Congress?
membership_rule: Includes major federal voting or election administration bills designated as top legislative priorities by Senate leadership during unified or semi-unified control cycles; excludes routine appropriations and non-controversial bipartisan technical fixes.

cases.name: Help America Vote Act amendments / major partisan election bills in unified control

provenance_note: 3 cases named, 4 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x); rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major designated electoral priority pushes observed across recent Congresses; none achieved passage due to intra-party will deficits on threshold rules.
known_gaps: Excludes minor provisions folded quietly into omnibus packages.
skeleton: Major partisan electoral bills introduced as top priorities under Senate party control since 2001
multiplier: 0 hits out of 4 major attempts due to intense polarization and internal caucus threshold requirements
validity_reason: Holds until the current Senate operational rules or polarization structure fundamentally shifts.
